<arc/>Arc and <kinetic/>Kinetic Kills charge an <arc/>Ionic Sentry. Weapon kills grant <pve 1 /> <pvp [2] /> charge, while ability kills grant <pve 2 /> <pvp [?] /> charges.

At 6 charges, replaces your Grenade Ability with a throwable <arc/>Ionic Sentry. Ionic Sentry <arc/>Blinds on impact within a 5 meter radius for <pve 10 /> <pvp [5] /> seconds. Incurs a 6 second cooldown upon being thrown.

<arc/>Ionic Sentry lasts for 15 seconds and shoots chain lightning at targets within a 16 meter radius once every second. Enemies hit by this attack chain the lightning to one additional target within a 6 meter radius.

Grants x1 <arc/>Bolt Charge per enemy hit.

Ionic Sentry counts as a Grenade Ability and is buffed by, and triggers, grenade-specific effects.
